title: Pure Hieratic
summary: Hieratic cards only, with generic Links and staples. Hieratic is a LIGHT Dragon Xyz deck that tributes its own monsters for value. Most Hieratic Dragons summon a Dragon Normal Monster from the hand, Deck or GY with 0 ATK/DEF when they are tributed. Here those Normals are Hieratic's own: Hieratic Seal of the Sun Dragon Overlord (Level 8) and Hieratic Seal of the Dragon King (Level 6, a Gemini treated as a Normal). Hieratic Dragon of Su and Hieratic Dragon of Nebthet summon themselves by tributing a Hieratic, then tribute another from the hand to destroy a Spell/Trap or a monster. Hieratic Dragon of Gebeb brings out a Hieratic Normal when tributed, and Hieratic Seal of Convocation searches any Hieratic. The 2021 cards lead the Xyz end. Hieratic Seal of Creation turns a Dragon Xyz into a different Hieratic Xyz, and Hieratic Sky Dragon Overlord of Heliopolis negates anything that targets your cards.
